mapper.select: SELECT p.pay50_expense_id AS expense_id , p.pay50_occ_date AS occ_date , p.pay50_desc AS "desc" , p.pay50_content AS content , COALESCE(sys15_corp_nm, f_emp_kor_nm(p.pay50_corp_id)) AS corp_name , p.pay50_amt AS amt , p.pay50_tax AS tax , p.pay50_settle_amt AS settle_amt , f_cdnm('TaxType' , p.pay50_tax_type , p.pay50_company_id, p.ref_date) AS tax_type_name , p.pay50_due_date AS due_date , p.pay50_pay_method_cd AS pay_method_code , f_cdnm('PayMethodCode', p.pay50_pay_method_cd , p.pay50_company_id, p.ref_date) AS pay_method_name , p.pay50_pay_account_info AS pay_account_info , p.pay50_note AS note , f_get_empTrans(p.pay50_reg_emp_id , p.pay50_reg_date, 'title_nm') AS reg_emp_title_name , f_get_empTrans(p.pay50_reg_emp_id , p.ref_date, 'person_org_info') AS reg_emp_org_name , f_get_empTrans(p.pay50_confirmer_id, p.pay50_reg_date, 'title_nm') AS confirmer_title_name , f_get_empTrans(p.pay50_confirmer_id, p.pay50_reg_date, 'person_org_info') AS confirmer_org_name , f_get_empTrans(p.pay50_reg_emp_id , p.pay50_reg_date, 'org_code_nm') AS org_name , f_get_account_nm(p.pay50_company_id, p.pay50_account_cd) AS account_name , ast01_class_tree_nm AS deposit_name , p.pay50_settle_date AS settle_date FROM ( SELECT x.* , CASE WHEN #{byDueDate} THEN x.pay50_due_date ELSE x.pay50_reg_date END AS ref_date FROM pay50_expense x WHERE x.pay50_company_id = #{companyId} AND x.pay50_expense_id IN #{id} ) p LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = p.pay50_corp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = p.pay50_deposit_id

SELECT a.com01_appr_id AS target_appr_id , MAX(b.apr01_reg_date) AS reg_date , MAX(b.apr01_title) AS title , MAX(b.apr01_inout_cd) AS in_out_type_code FROM com01_relate_appr a INNER JOIN apr01_appr b ON b.apr01_appr_id = a.com01_appr_id WHERE a.com01_key_table_id IN #{id} GROUP BY a.com01_appr_id

SELECT a.pay50_expense_appr_id AS target_appr_id , MAX(b.apr01_reg_date) AS reg_date , MAX(b.apr01_title) AS title , MAX(b.apr01_inout_cd) AS in_out_type_code FROM pay50_expense a INNER JOIN apr01_appr b ON b.apr01_appr_id = a.pay50_expense_appr_id WHERE a.pay50_expense_id IN #{id} GROUP BY a.pay50_expense_appr_id

SELECT ast13_item_type AS item_type , sum(ast13_pur_amt) AS pur_amt FROM ( SELECT ast13_pur_amt , ast01_item_s_class_cd , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ast01_item_s_class_cd,5,2) = '99' THEN f_cdnm('ItemMClassCode', ast01_item_m_class_cd, ast13_company_id, ast13_pur_date) WHEN SUBSTR(ast01_item_s_class_cd,1,2) = '95' THEN '소모품(비품)' ELSE f_cdnm('ItemSClassCode', ast01_item_s_class_cd, ast13_company_id, ast13_pur_date) END ast13_item_type FROM ast13_book_depn a INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = ast13_ast_class_tree_id WHERE ast13_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast13_depn_date = ( SELECT MAX(ast13_depn_date) FROM ast13_book_depn b WHERE b.ast13_company_id = a.ast13_company_id AND b.ast13_pur_tr_id = a.ast13_pur_tr_id AND b.ast13_depn_date <= #{depnDate} ) AND COALESCE(ast13_retire_date,'9999-12-31') > #{depnDate} ) t GROUP BY ast01_item_s_class_cd, ast13_item_type ORDER BY ast01_item_s_class_cd

SELECT biz55_erp_fee_charge_id AS erp_fee_charge_id , biz55_erp_cont_corp_id AS erp_cont_corp_id , sys15_corp_nm AS corp_name , biz55_charge_date AS charge_date , biz55_start_date AS start_date , biz55_close_date AS close_date , biz55_erp_fee AS erp_fee , biz55_data_fee AS data_fee , biz55_add_sms_fee AS add_sms_fee , biz55_add_server_fee AS add_server_fee , biz55_add_user_fee AS add_user_fee , COALESCE(biz55_etc_amt,0) AS etc_amt , biz55_etc_desc AS etc_desc , (biz55_erp_fee + biz55_data_fee + biz55_add_sms_fee + biz55_add_server_fee + biz55_add_user_fee + biz55_etc_amt) AS total_amt , FLOOR((biz55_erp_fee + biz55_data_fee + biz55_add_sms_fee + biz55_add_server_fee + biz55_add_user_fee + biz55_etc_amt) * 0.1) AS total_vat , (biz55_erp_fee + biz55_data_fee + biz55_add_sms_fee + biz55_add_server_fee + biz55_add_user_fee + biz55_etc_amt) + FLOOR((biz55_erp_fee + biz55_data_fee + biz55_add_sms_fee + biz55_add_server_fee + biz55_add_user_fee + biz55_etc_amt) * 0.1) AS charge_amt , biz55_sms_count AS sms_count , biz55_server_usage AS server_usage , biz55_user_count AS user_count , (select BOOL_OR(COALESCE(biz52_add_fee_sms_yn::boolean, false)) from biz52_erp_fee where biz52_erp_cont_corp_id = biz55_erp_cont_corp_id and biz52_start_date <= biz55_close_date and COALESCE(biz52_close_date, current_timestamp) >= biz55_start_date ) AS add_fee_sms_yn , (select BOOL_OR(COALESCE(biz52_add_fee_server_yn::boolean, false)) from biz52_erp_fee where biz52_erp_cont_corp_id = biz55_erp_cont_corp_id and biz52_start_date <= biz55_close_date and COALESCE(biz52_close_date, current_timestamp) >= biz55_start_date ) AS add_fee_server_yn , (select BOOL_OR(COALESCE(biz52_add_fee_user_yn::boolean, false)) from biz52_erp_fee where biz52_erp_cont_corp_id = biz55_erp_cont_corp_id and biz52_start_date <= biz55_close_date and COALESCE(biz52_close_date, current_timestamp) >= biz55_start_date ) AS add_fee_user_yn , (select EXTRACT(YEAR FROM biz55_charge_date) || '.' || EXTRACT(MONTH FROM biz55_charge_date) || '.' || biz52_deposit_due_day from biz52_erp_fee where biz52_erp_cont_corp_id = biz55_erp_cont_corp_id and biz52_start_date <= biz55_close_date and COALESCE(biz52_close_date, current_timestamp) >= biz55_start_date order by biz52_start_date DESC limit 1) AS deposit_due_day FROM biz55_erp_fee_charge INNER JOIN biz51_erp_cont_corp ON biz51_erp_cont_corp_id = biz55_erp_cont_corp_id INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = biz51_corp_id WHERE biz55_erp_fee_charge_id = #{erpFeeChargeId}

SELECT biz52_sms_base_count AS sms_base_count , biz52_sms_add_price AS sms_add_price , biz52_server_base_usage AS server_base_usage , biz52_server_add_unit AS server_add_unit , biz52_server_add_price AS server_add_price , biz52_user_base_count AS user_base_count , biz52_user_add_price AS user_add_price , f_cdnm('UserCountStdMonthCode', biz52_user_count_std_cd, #{companyId}, biz52_start_date) AS user_count_std_str FROM biz52_erp_fee WHERE biz52_erp_cont_corp_id = #{erpContCorpId} AND #{stdDate} >= biz52_start_date ORDER BY biz52_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
